title: OmniJudge or OmniBias? Diagnosing Multimodal Judges through Balanced, Decoupled Lenses
abstract: arXiv:2608.24160v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal understanding models that can jointly judge text-to-image (T2I), text-to-video (T2V) and text-to-speech (TTS) generation are increasingly used as "OmniJudges" for evaluation and automatic annotation. How reliably they understand what they score remains unclear, since existing benchmarks and training data tend to overemphasize positive examples and to conflate distinct failure modes, so a judge may score well without recognizing failures while its capability gaps stay hidden. translated_title: OmniJudge还是OmniBias？通过平衡、解耦的视角诊断多模态裁判模型
translated_abstract: 能够联合评判文本到图像（T2I）、文本到视频（T2V）和文本到语音（TTS）生成的多模态理解模型，正越来越多地被用作“全能裁判”（OmniJudges）进行评价和自动标注。然而，它们对自身所评分内容的理解可靠性仍不明确，因为现有基准和训练数据往往过度强调正例，并混淆不同失败模式，导致裁判模型可能在未识别失败的情况下得分良好，而其能力缺陷却被隐藏。基于此，我们引入了D3-Omni，一个平衡且解耦的基准，用于诊断细粒度多模态理解，涵盖三个任务中的53个正交二元维度（17/22/14）和10,671个样本（3,526/1,998/5,147）。我们不重新生成输出（这可能在不同维度间泄露信息），而是固定经过验证的完全正例种子，并通过受控提示改写和原子化、维度隔离的扰动来生成负例。
tldr: 本文提出D3-Omni基准，通过平衡、解耦的维度设计，诊断多模态裁判模型在T2I、T2V和TTS任务中的细粒度理解能力，揭示其隐藏的失败模式。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces D3-Omni, a balanced and decoupled benchmark to diagnose fine-grained multimodal understanding of OmniJudges across T2I, T2V, and TTS tasks, revealing hidden capability gaps.
